project.title: Cloud Services Directorate, Cloud Platform Engineering
project.role: AWS Cloud Infrastructure as Code DevOps Engineer & Architect

parentsummary.deliverables: Designed and delivered the enterprise-class AWS EKS-based GitOps platform for SSC's Hosting Services Branch Cloud Platform Engineering team, implementing Kubernetes architecture patterns with ArgoCD and Argo Workflows, Security By Design controls, Infrastructure as Code development using Terraform and Crossplane, source code management via Azure DevOps, and workload onboarding support across multiple government departments.
parentsummary.outcomes: Architected and deployed an enterprise-class GitOps platform serving multiple government departments through AWS EKS and ArgoCD, and established Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform and Crossplane enabling rapid deployment of NIST 800-53 compliant workloads across SSC's AWS Landing Zone Accelerator platform.

challenge.summary: The Cloud Services Platform Engineering team operates within the Hosting Services Branch providing an Enterprise class Tenancy within the Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud, supporting AWS ASEA (Secure Accelerator) and AWS LZA (Landing Zone Accelerator) platform designs.

deliverables: Needs analysis, defining requirements, defining and maintain deliverable scopes
AWS and Kubernetes design patterns and architecture
Security By Design patterns and principles
Workload and Application Deployment and Support
Implemented Source Code Management, DevOps Toolings, and DevOps Best Practices

outcomes: ✅ Successfully architected and deployed enterprise-class GitOps platform serving multiple government departments through AWS EKS and ArgoCD
✅ Established Infrastructure as Code standards using Terraform and Crossplane, enabling rapid deployment of NIST 800-53 compliant workloads across SSC's AWS Landing Zone Accelerator platform
